node.statement: If u_R is bijective, its extended D*t-inclusion lower norm bound and node 1.3 imply ||v_R(x)||>=||u_R(x)||-||(v_R-u_R)(x)||>=(1-(1+K_disp)*D*t)||x||=(1-q)||x||>=||x||/2 for every x in B_R. Thus v_R is injective. Bijectivity of u_R identifies the finite dimensions of B_R and A_R, so v_R is bijective. By def-extended-delta-inclusion it is an extended K_floor*epsilon_R-isomorphism, and lem-maincb-extended-inclusion-monotone upgrades it to an extended W.c0_cb*epsilon_R-isomorphism.
